subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinanceCo evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tran <sarah.tran@financeco.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@financeco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinanceCo evaluation

Hi Sarah / Michael,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciate you both carving out time. Quick recap and a proposed 2-week POC plan so we can align on success criteria, owners, and next steps.

Demo highlights (recap):
- Walked through retrieval-augmented generation with Redwood's streaming API (latency ~200ms p/token in our hosted profile we showed).
- Showed how prefix caching reduces repeat costs for repeated queries (relevant to your batch of monthly statements).
- Reviewed role-based access + audit logs for data access.

Proposed POC objective:
- Evaluate Redwood's ability to: 1) reliably answer customer billing & reconciliation questions from ingested statements and 2) meet SLA-like latency and cost targets in your typical workload.

Success criteria (suggested):
1) Accuracy: >= 85% on a 200-question eval set (we'll co-develop sample prompts).
2) Latency: 95th percentile < 400ms for single-turn Q&A on your 8k-context tests.
3) Cost: target token cost per query that keeps monthly estimate within your budget (we'll provide estimates once we see sample traffic).
4) Ops: ability to ingest and query your statement set with RBAC + audit logging turned on.

Proposed timeline & ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): sign POC agreement + share sample dataset + grant SE access. (Owner: FinanceCo procurement / Marissa)
- Week 1: Redwood SE (David) ingests data, runs initial eval, and iterates on prompt set. (Owner: David / FinanceCo data lead)
- Week 2: Final evaluation, runbook handoff, and wrap — decision or next steps.

Attachments: 20260315-demo-deck.pdf, poc-eval-plan.xlsx (evaluation outline + suggested prompts).

Immediate next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm you want to move forward with the POC (reply to confirm).
2) Share sample data (anonymized subset of statements) or data schema by Tue 3/17.
3) Nikhil and I will send a short POC SOW and a calendar invite for kick-off (30–45m).

If a 2-week timeline is aggressive for your procurement, we can extend to 3 weeks — happy to adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: 20260315-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 9 slides)
Attachment: poc-eval-plan.xlsx (Excel, evaluation checklist and timeline)
From: Sarah Tran <sarah.tran@financeco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@financeco.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinanceCo evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap and outline — the team here is interested. A few clarifying Qs before we confirm:

1) Data/sample requirements: what format do you need for the statements (CSV, JSON, PDF)? Any size recommendations for an initial eval?
2) Timeline: procurement will likely need 2–3 business days to approve a standard non-prod agreement; a 3-week POC might be safer on our side.
3) Budget/credits: can Redwood provide trial credits or a capped spend for the evaluation? We want to ensure we don't inadvertently exceed internal spend approvals.

Also looping in Michael (ops) — Michael, can you share who on your side should be the data owner and whether we can provide an anonymized S3 bucket?

If we can get the data format and credits clarified, I think we can confirm and target a Fri 3/19 kick-off.

Thanks,
Sarah
Director, Billing Product | FinanceCo
S: sarah.tran@financeco.com | M: (212) 555-7890
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tran <sarah.tran@financeco.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@financeco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinanceCo evaluation

Hi Sarah / Michael — great questions. Quick answers below and a couple of tweaks to the plan based on your note about procurement.

1) Data format & sample size:
- Preferred: CSV or newline-delimited JSON for structured ingestion. If you only have PDFs, we can accept a sample set and run an extraction pass, but structured is faster to iterate on.
- Suggested initial sample: ~2k statements / 50–200MB (anonymized). For the eval set (accuracy measurement) we'd like ~200 labeled Q&A pairs derived from those statements (we can co-author these).

2) Timeline:
- We can extend to a 3-week POC to accommodate procurement. Proposed adjusted timeline: Kick-off week (procurement + data access), Week 2 ingestion + baseline, Week 3 iteration + final eval.

3) Credits / spend cap:
- Redwood can provide an evaluation credit of 500k tokens (no charge). If you need a hard spend cap beyond that, we can include a capped billing clause in the POC SOW.

Next steps I propose:
- Michael: please confirm the data owner and whether an anonymized S3 bucket is available (or confirm alternative transfer).
- Sarah: if you confirm a 3-week POC, we'll send an updated POC SOW and a calendar invite for a 30–45m kick-off (possible times: Fri 3/19 10–11am PT or Mon 3/22 9–10am PT).
- David (cc'd) will reach out to collect sample schema and schedule a short technical intake.

I'll attach an updated poc-eval-plan.xlsx with the 3-week timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to confirmation.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: poc-eval-plan.xlsx (updated: 3-week timeline)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tran <sarah.tran@financeco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@financeco.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinanceCo evaluation

Hi all — quick technical follow-up and checklist so FinanceCo knows what we'll need to start ingestion and the first baseline run.

Required / preferred items:
- Data format: CSV or NDJSON with one statement per row/document. If only PDFs available, provide a small batch (10–20) and we'll validate extraction quality.
- Schema: fields we prefer: statement_id, customer_id (anonymized), statement_date, line_items (JSON blob or delimited field), total_amount. Sample CSV header example included in the poc-eval-plan.xlsx.
- Transfer options: presigned S3 link (preferred) OR secure SFTP. We can also set up a temporary upload bucket in your AWS account with cross-account role; David will send a short IAM recipe if preferred.
- Test dataset size: for performance/QoS measurement, ~1k–2k statements; for accuracy eval we need 200 Q&A pairs sampled across common question types (billing dispute, charge breakdown, refund status).

Security notes:
- We are SOC 2 Type II compliant; we'll run ingestion in an isolated non-prod project and enable audit logging. If you have an internal checklist, please share and we can map controls.

Operational offer:
- I can run a 45–60 minute intake/runbook session during week 1 to walk through data handoff and ingestion steps. Proposed slots: Thu 3/18 11am PT or Fri 3/19 9am PT.

Let me know which transfer mechanism you prefer and I'll send a secure upload link and a short intake form.

Thanks,
David Kim
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0124
